palette_rationale: Preserve the reviewed dark body, blue wings, yellow source eyes, white claws/skull, and red claw tips within the Idle palette; no invented marks or projectile.
reference: Own DSTS chr097 model and native clips. PMDO engine registry supplies action names, frame timing fields and events.
flight_policy: Source wing and vertical motion retained. Airborne placement uses one fixed transform per action across all frames and directions, a stationary shadow row 48, and a minimum four-pixel gap.

actions.name: Walk
actions.pose_evidence: Native short-cycle flight with alternating wingbeats; endpoint excluded.

actions.name: Attack
actions.pose_evidence: Native body and claw lunge; no forced landing.

actions.name: Shoot
actions.pose_evidence: Native face/wing expression release; no projectile asset.

actions.name: Sleep
actions.pose_evidence: Native resting wing/body motion. Source eyes appear open; do not invent eyelids.

actions.name: Hurt
actions.pose_evidence: Native recoil and wing disturbance; bd02/bd03 are more extreme.

actions.name: Swing
actions.pose_evidence: Native wide wing/claw sweep without weapon.

actions.name: Double
actions.pose_evidence: Two native lunge cycles. PMDO XML exposes one HitFrame.

actions.name: Hop
actions.pose_evidence: Native distinct flight lift/wingbeat; remains airborne throughout.

actions.name: Charge
actions.pose_evidence: Native raised wings and strain with reverse-sampled recovery; no added effect.

actions.name: Rotate
actions.pose_evidence: Native face/wing motion and explicit whole-view yaw; endpoint excluded.
